channel.title: Step Security Blog
channel.description: The latest from StepSecurity — practical guidance, product updates, and threat insights to help secure your CI/CD pipelines and stay ahead of supply chain attacks

item.title: GitHub Package Firewall vs. StepSecurity Secure Registry: Protection beyond npm
item.description: GitHub’s package firewall covers npm only. StepSecurity's Secure Registry protects 8 ecosystems, traces every install, and blocks malicious packages within an hour

item.title: Railway’s Security Incident: Why CI/CD Needs Runtime Security
item.description: Lessons from Railway’s November 10 report: review build access, tighten OIDC trust, and use Harden-Runner to observe and restrict CI/CD runtime activity.

item.title: @ethersphere/bee-js 13.3.0 Compromised
item.description: @ethersphere/bee-js 13.3.0 is compromised. Malicious install-time code targets Swarm wallet data and attempts to establish persistent access on affected systems.
